why_ai: Generative assistants already absorbed homework help, though some families still pay for a trusted tutor.
why_clarity: Sessions repeat endlessly, but nobody measures whether tutoring produced learning.
why_digital: Matching, video sessions and payment all happen online.

why_ai: Diagnosing gaps from prior sessions and student work is a well-posed AI task.
why_clarity: Prerequisite gaps are identifiable from student work, though root causes vary.
why_digital: Session transcripts and student work analysed on screen.

why_ai: Causal claims need outside assessment data and careful study design AI cannot shortcut.
why_clarity: Learning gains and causation surface months later through school assessments, if ever.
why_digital: Assessment and grade data analysed digitally for districts and platforms.

why_ai: Ranking and recommendation are already fully automated marketplace algorithms.
why_clarity: Ranking runs on every search, but the right objective is contested.
why_digital: Search and recommendation engines run entirely online.

why_ai: Summarising a held session transcript into a parent note is a direct LLM task.
why_clarity: A weekly note per student from a transcript is repetitive and well defined.
why_digital: Transcripts in, written reports to parents out, all digital.

why_ai: Booking, cancellation rules and no-show prediction are rule-based and fully automatable.
why_clarity: Cancellation policy is a rule applied identically to every booking.
why_digital: Calendars, reminders and payments run entirely online.

why_ai: Transcription and discourse analysis of recorded sessions are mature AI capabilities.
why_clarity: Talk ratio, wait time and questioning are countable against teaching research.
why_digital: Session recordings analysed entirely in software.

why_ai: Families value a specific tutor relationship, but AI tutors substitute much of the instruction.
why_clarity: Each student needs different teaching, and learning outcomes are rarely measured.
why_digital: Tutoring delivered over video to students anywhere.

why_ai: Quality instruments computable from recordings let software replace most manual review.
why_clarity: Teaching quality has no agreed measure beyond ratings and complaints.
why_digital: Ratings, recordings and complaint queues reviewed on screen.

why_ai: In-session scoring is automatable, and the hard outcome half is data-limited.
why_clarity: Telling helpful from liked tutors lacks an agreed, fast outcome measure.
why_digital: Session and outcome data analysed entirely in software.

why_ai: Unsupervised adult-child contact creates serious safeguarding accountability and adversarial monitoring.
why_clarity: Background checks are codified and repeated, though grooming detection is uncertain.
why_digital: Checks and message monitoring run entirely online.
